title: Taking Time Out of TOCTOU: From Race Reproduction to Security Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.21214v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Time-of-check-to-time-of-use (TOCTOU) races are hard to reproduce and lost races can make vulnerable programs look fixed. We present Chronos, a framework that separates intervention timing from verdict evidence and builds reusable one-trial security regression oracles from declared races for deterministic reproduction, commit bisection and CI. Race Specifications compose reusable hold engines, actions, observers and outcome rules. When the declared hold is reached and the attack completes while held, Chronos orders it before the use under blocking and interference assumptions. Chronos uses seccomp notifications to enforce declared hold-attack-release ordering at syscall boundaries on stock Linux; ptrace and a KVM guest gate provide holds at userspace and kernel instruction sites. One decision procedure labels every mechanism's runs: fixed requires positive, case-specific evidence of preservation, justified refusal, omission under check

translated_title: 从TOCTOU中剥离时间因素：从竞态复现到安全发现
translated_abstract: 检查时到使用时（TOCTOU）竞态难以复现，而竞态丢失会使存在漏洞的程序看起来已被修复。我们提出了Chronos，这是一个将干预时机与判定证据相分离的框架，它从声明的竞态构建可复用的一次性安全回归oracle，用于确定性复现、提交二分定位和持续集成（CI）。竞态规范由可复用的保持引擎、动作、观察者和结果规则组合而成。当声明的保持被达成且攻击在保持期间完成时，Chronos在阻塞和干扰假设下将该攻击排序在使用点之前。Chronos使用seccomp通知在原版Linux的系统调用边界处强制执行声明的保持-攻击-释放顺序；ptrace和KVM客户机门则可在用户空间和内核指令位置提供保持。一个统一的决策过程为每种机制的运行结果打标签：fixed（已修复）需要针对具体情况的、积极的防护保存证据，justified refusal（合理拒绝）以及检查下的遗漏……
tldr: Chronos框架通过seccomp、ptrace和KVM等多种机制将TOCTOU竞态攻击的干预时机与判定证据分离，从而实现对竞态漏洞的确定性复现、提交二分定位和CI安全回归测试。
en_tdlr: Chronos is a framework that separates intervention timing from verdict evidence for TOCTOU races, enabling deterministic reproduction, commit bisection, and CI security regression testing through seccomp, ptrace, and KVM mechanisms.
